description.value: Deer Garden Signatures is a well-known Richmond noodle restaurant group celebrated for their signature fish soup rice noodles (魚湯米線) made without MSG. The Alexandra Road flagship sits in Richmond's busy 'food street' corridor, a popular dining destination in the city's heart. Cyclists will find a substantial sit-down meal with online pre-ordering available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 51m; rack at 54m; rack at 87m; rack at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Deer Garden Signatures is an active multi-location Chinese noodle restaurant group in Richmond/Vancouver. The OSM coordinates (49.1740447, -123.1496477) align with the Alexandra Rd area in Richmond, matching the DG1 flagship location at 8580 Alexandra Rd #2015. The website provides address and phone for DG1, confirms online ordering and party trays (indicating takeout), but contains no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both populated from website for the DG1 (Alexandra Rd) location based on coordinate proximity — should be verified on-site.
Website navigation references two additional locations (Capstan Way 新城市店 and Sperling Ave 本拿比店) that do not appear in the main Locations section, suggesting those branches may have closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible dine-in restaurant with active website and online ordering. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.

wow_evidence: well-known Richmond noodle restaurant group... Alexandra Road flagship sits in Richmond's busy 'food street' corridor
